## Conversion of Marco Prinz atlas from RDS to h5ad

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(zellkonverter)

obj <- readRDS("../data/Mouse_Myeloid_atlas_v1.RDS")
#sce <- as.SingleCellExperiment(obj)
#writeH5AD(sce, "../data/Mouse_Myeloid_atlas_v1.h5ad")
```

```{r}
# metdata
colnames(obj@meta.data)
```

```{r}
meta <- obj@meta.data

is_cat <- sapply(meta, function(x) is.factor(x) || is.character(x) || is.logical(x))

# Categorical: tables
lapply(meta[, is_cat, drop = FALSE], function(x) table(x, useNA = "ifany"))

# Numeric: summary stats
lapply(meta[, !is_cat, drop = FALSE], summary)
```

## Reducing the size of the seurat object before conversion

otherwise it won't run.

```{r}
obj <- DietSeurat(
  obj,
  assays     = "RNA",
  layers     = c("counts", "data"),   # use counts=TRUE, data=TRUE, scale.data=FALSE in Seurat v4
  dimreducs  = c("pca", "umap"),      # keep only what you need
  graphs     = NULL
)
gc()
```

```{r}
cols_to_drop <- c("percent.mt", "Subclass_color", "Tissue_color", "Condition_color",
                  "Module_id", "Context_region", "nCount_RNA",
                  "Context_stagewise_Controls_merged", "Subclass_id_label",
                  "Tissue_label", "Condition_label", "Condition_id",
                  "Module_color", "relabelled_clusters")

obj@meta.data <- obj@meta.data[, setdiff(colnames(obj@meta.data), cols_to_drop), drop = FALSE]
```

# Piece by piece conversion

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)

obj <- readRDS("../data/Mouse_Myeloid_atlas_v1.RDS")
DefaultAssay(obj) <- "RNA"

out <- "/home/anitag/ST_Brambilla_local/data/h5ad_parts"
dir.create(out, showWarnings = FALSE)

# check the reduction names match what you expect
Reductions(obj)   # should include "pca" and "umap"

# --- small things first ---
write.csv(obj@meta.data,           file.path(out, "metadata.csv"))
write.csv(Embeddings(obj, "pca"),  file.path(out, "pca.csv"))
write.csv(Embeddings(obj, "umap"), file.path(out, "umap.csv"))
writeLines(rownames(obj[["RNA"]]), file.path(out, "genes.txt"))
writeLines(colnames(obj),          file.path(out, "barcodes.txt"))

# --- matrices (Seurat v4: use GetAssayData(obj, slot = "counts") instead) ---
counts <- LayerData(obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
data   <- LayerData(obj, assay = "RNA", layer = "data")
rm(obj); gc()   # the object itself is no longer needed

dump_layer <- function(mat, name, chunk = 50000) {
  n <- ncol(mat)
  starts <- seq(1, n, by = chunk)
  for (k in seq_along(starts)) {
    idx <- starts[k]:min(starts[k] + chunk - 1, n)
    m <- as(mat[, idx, drop = FALSE], "CsparseMatrix")
    base <- file.path(out, sprintf("%s_%03d", name, k))
    writeBin(m@i, paste0(base, "_i.bin"))                       # int32
    writeBin(m@p, paste0(base, "_p.bin"))                       # int32
    writeBin(as.numeric(m@x), paste0(base, "_x.bin"), size = 4) # float32
    rm(m); gc()
    message(name, ": chunk ", k, "/", length(starts))
  }
}

dump_layer(counts, "counts"); rm(counts); gc()
dump_layer(data,   "data");   rm(data);   gc()
```

Switching to python (just run this script somewhere else)

```{python}
import glob
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import scipy.sparse as sp
import anndata as ad

d = "/home/anitag/ST_Brambilla_local/data/h5ad_parts/"
genes    = open(d + "genes.txt").read().splitlines()
barcodes = open(d + "barcodes.txt").read().splitlines()
n_genes = len(genes)

def load_layer(name):
    mats = []
    for pfile in sorted(glob.glob(f"{d}{name}_*_p.bin")):
        base = pfile[:-6]
        p = np.fromfile(base + "_p.bin", dtype=np.int32)
        i = np.fromfile(base + "_i.bin", dtype=np.int32)
        x = np.fromfile(base + "_x.bin", dtype=np.float32)
        m = sp.csc_matrix((x, i, p), shape=(n_genes, len(p) - 1))
        mats.append(m.T.tocsr())          # genes x cells -> cells x genes
    return sp.vstack(mats, format="csr")

counts = load_layer("counts")
data   = load_layer("data")
assert counts.shape == data.shape == (len(barcodes), n_genes)

obs = pd.read_csv(d + "metadata.csv", index_col=0)
assert list(obs.index) == barcodes        # same cell order as the matrices

adata = ad.AnnData(X=data, obs=obs, var=pd.DataFrame(index=genes))
adata.layers["counts"] = counts
adata.obsm["X_pca"]  = pd.read_csv(d + "pca.csv",  index_col=0).loc[adata.obs_names].values
adata.obsm["X_umap"] = pd.read_csv(d + "umap.csv", index_col=0).loc[adata.obs_names].values

adata.write_h5ad("/home/anitag/ST_Brambilla_local/data/Mouse_Myeloid_atlas_v1.h5ad", compression="gzip")
print(adata)
```
